# TLS certificate expiry (`source_type: tls_cert`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connects with TLS and reports the days until the certificate expires.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `days`: days until the certificate expires

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | yes | string |  |  |
| `port` | no | integer | `443` | 1 to 65535 |
| `warn_days` | no | integer | `30` | 1 to 365 |
| `critical_days` | no | integer | `7` | 1 to 365 |

## Rules

- `warn_days` must be at least `critical_days`.
- Thresholds still decide status: for example healthy `over` 30, unhealthy `under` 7.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: tls_cert
source_config: {"host":"api.example.com","port":443}
```
